name: Sturgeon-head hotpot
summary: Go Vietnam says sturgeon is farmed in the cold water at Măng Đen, and the head is cooked as a hotpot with sour bamboo shoots, tomato, lemongrass, and chili.
origin: Go Vietnam’s Măng Đen article names the hotpot and ties the fish to cold-water farms on that plateau.
taste: Go Vietnam prints a clean sweetness and says the fish is not fishy.
howToEat: A pot of sturgeon head with sour bamboo, tomato, lemongrass, and chili. The article prints 400,000–700,000 VND for a pot for 4 people. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Măng Đen, Kon Plông, on that article. Not the Kon Tum market breakfast.
priceBand: Go Vietnam’s Măng Đen article prints 400,000–700,000 VND for a pot for 4 people.
seoDescription: Farmed sturgeon head in a hotpot with sour bamboo, tomato, lemongrass, and chili. Go Vietnam prints 400,000–700,000 VND for 4 people in Măng Đen.
